response.sql: SELECT r.name, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId WHERE cs.points > 6.0 GROUP BY r.name;

assumptions.assumption: "Clear the 6.0-point threshold" means season-to-date points strictly greater than 6.0, so entries with exactly 6.0 are excluded.
Missing win counts are skipped by AVG, and a race name whose kept entries all have NULL wins returns NULL. Missing points are excluded by the WHERE clause, since NULL > 6.0 is not true.
The average is computed over all kept constructor-standing rows for each race name, across all years and rounds sharing that name, with no rounding applied.

alternatives.interpretation: "Clear the threshold" is read as reaching it, so entries with season-to-date points of at least 6.0 are kept.
